name: Unity
about: Unity (1998-069F), a crewed vehicle (ISS Node), launched 1998 Dec  4. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (AO).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1998 Dec 10), held fixed
